what: Files written by earlier versions of the MCP tool annotate_metadata (src/embpy/mcp/tools.py), dumped as JSON: the .obs columns and .uns['embpy_annotations'] exactly as the written .h5ad held them. tests/test_mcp_annotation.py rebuilds each .h5ad from its dump.
how: Each version's src was taken with `git archive <commit> src` and imported through PYTHONPATH; the tool's lookups (_annotation_fetchers) were replaced by fixed offline answers, and the calls listed under 'calls' were run on a new .h5ad holding only the identifier column.

files.b6dc03c_gene_go.json: commit b6dc03c (the reviewed PR head): gene GO terms of TP53 (3) and EGFR (2), organism human, column 'gene'
files.0eec156_gene_then_protein_diseases.json: commit 0eec156: gene diseases (open_targets 5, gwas_catalog 1), then protein diseases (uniprot 2) of the same column 'gene'; that version stored both in one identifier -> type -> source record and counted 8 in both count columns
